statement: The continuous multiplier-preserving descent map from the full pure peripheral outer group P onto GT0 is surjective, also on multiplier-one subgroups; surjectivity of its restriction to GT0 is not asserted.
notes: Root and FGH complete independent proof audits PASS. H2 of the actual modular target is zero, so the source-centralization kernel embeds in the actual free abelianization. This kills the lifted three-peripheral product discrepancy; the induced centralization map fixes its kernel and is an automorphism. The closed-normal central lifting criterion produces a full peripheral preimage. An actual Galois multiplier correction gives all multipliers. The source S3 symmetry is the precise remaining gate for gentle surjectivity; no all-iterate independence conclusion follows.
